_help: Go preset (go vet / go test / go build, plus a gofmt check). Each gate runs in the repo root; every required gate must exit 0 before a slice can be marked verified. Adjust targets to match this repo; swap the lint gate for golangci-lint if you use it.
session_budget_hint: A slice should fit one agent session: ~1 vertical behavior, < ~10 files touched, tests included. If it won't fit in your head, split it.
